goal: Read the concrete Fixed Asset G/L Journal Batch Name value or prove that it is not exposed, without selecting a value or changing journal data.

triggeredBy.decision: FA-281 proved only the Batch Name label, not an actual batch value or FADEP target.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central remains in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
No Batch Name value is selected or changed.
No journal line is created, edited or deleted.
No Calculate Depreciation OK, Preview Posting, Post, setup change, company switch or API shortcut occurs.
The run captures a concrete Batch Name value or documents why the value is not exposed.
stopConditions: Instance or company is not explicit.
Reading the batch value requires edit mode.
Opening the dropdown would select or change a value.
The diagnosis would require writing field values.
nextSafeAction: Run a focused read-only batch-value probe on Fixed Asset G/L Journals; do not select, edit, OK, Preview Posting or Post.
